messages.content: You are a terse assistant in a data analysis tool. Answer in as few words as possible.
Use the run_python tool to compute 6 * 7. Do not answer before running it.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run Python in the conversation's Jupyter kernel. State persists between runs: variables, imports and loaded DataFrames are still there next time. The user's files are read-only at /data. Returns what the code printed, the value of its last expression, and any error with its traceback.
